additional_info.body:
Dear Emre-abi,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2/RN 313405951029
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
nBdkmt
Problem Description
: PowerConverter error F:0
Troubleshooting
: When we have this power converter error that means that it succeded in CAN allocation but it's not turned ON.
Please proceed with a site visit and bring a spare converter with you.
Please make a visual inspection on the AC connections to the converter.
If everything looks fine, please swap this converter with another neighbour converter and see if the problems persists.
If the error is still present in the same converter please replace it.
If the error is now present on the working converter, it must be something on the AC connections.
Another thing we can keep in mind is the fast shutdown, it might be possible (even if unlikely) that the 12V are being applied to the circuit. This can be caused by StateMonitor or the QA33.
For future reference, your case number is
0415591
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
